decision_conditions:
<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">The proposed development would be poorly configured with inappropriate stacking arrangements between Flat 4 and Flats 2 and 3 below giving rise to impacts of harmful noise transference. In light of the above, prospective occupants would be provided with a substandard from of accommodation contrary to the high quality design aspirations of the National Planning Policy Framework (2023)&nbsp; policy D3 D (7) of The London Plan
(2021), policies, DM1 C, DM1 D (g) and DM26 E of the Harrow Development
Management Policies Local Plan (2013), and the adopted Supplementary Planning Documents Residential Design
Guide (2010).</p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">The proposed dormer by reason its of poor design,
excessive width and prominent siting would not be sympathetic to, or complement the
existing character of the original dwellinghouse,
appearing as an incongruous feature in the streetscene and resulting in undue harm to the
character and appearance of the area. The impact of the dormer is compounded by the fact that it sits alongside the bulky roof form of the proposed first floor side extension to No. 23. The proposed development would therefore be contrary to the high quality design
aspirations of the National Planning Policy Framework (2023), Policies D3 D (1) and (11) of the
London Plan (2021), Core Policy CS1 (B) of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), Policies DM 1 A, DM1 B (a), (b) (c) and DM26 A (g) of the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013) and
the adopted Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010).</p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;"><span style="line-height: 106%;">By reason of the fact that
the site is located within an area of land liable to flooding, and insufficient
information has been provided within the submitted Flood Risk Assessment to in
relation to; compensatory flood storage, the applicant has failed to demonstrate that the proposed
development would not exacerbate the risk of flooding within the site or
increase the risk and consequences of flooding elsewhere. The proposal would
thereby be contrary to the to the National Planning Policy Framework (20213,
Policy SI 12 and SI 13 of the London Plan (2021), </span><span style="line-height: 106%;">Policy
CS1.U and CS1.W of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), Policies DM9 and DM10 of the Harrow Development Management
Policies Local Plan (2013).</span><br></p>

<p class="MsoListParagraph" style="margin-bottom: 0cm; line-height: normal;">The proposed first floor side extension to No. 23 would appear as an unduly incongruous and dominant addition to the street scene due to its excessive visibility and prominence. Furthermore, the addition of the extension would unbalance the pair of semi-detached dwellings resulting in a loss of visual amenity afforded along the street scene. The visual impact of the proposed first floor side extension is compounded by the fact that it would it would sit alongside the bulky rear dormer.&nbsp; The proposal would therefore be contrary to the high quality design of
the National Planning Policy Framework (2023), Policy D3 D (1) and (11) of the London Plan
(2021), Core Policy CS1 (B) of the Harrow Core Strategy (2012), policy DM 1 A, DM1 B (a), (b) (c) and DM26 A (g) of
the Harrow Development Management Policies Local Plan (2013) and the adopted
Supplementary Planning Document: Residential Design Guide (2010).</p>
description: Conversion of two dwellings into four flats (2 X studio flats; 1 X 2 bed and 1 X 3 bed); single storey front infill extension; single storey rear extension to both Nos. 21 & 23; first floor side extension; conversion of garage to habitable room to No.23; alterations and extension to raise roof height; rear dormers and rooflight in front roofslope to both Nos. 21 & 23; external alterations; separate amenity space; parking; cycle and refuse storage (part demolition of rear extensions to both Nos.21 & 23 and outbuildings to No.21; demolition of rear dormer to No.23)
